005package org.wpilib.simulation;
006
007import org.wpilib.util.Alert.Level;
008import org.wpilib.util.AlertDataJNI;
009
010/** Simulation for alerts. */
011public final class AlertSim {
012  private AlertSim() {
013    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
014  }
015
016  /** Information about an alert. */
017  public static class AlertInfo {
018    AlertInfo(AlertDataJNI.AlertInfo info) {
019      this.group = info.group;
020      this.id = info.id;
021      this.text = info.text;
022      this.activeStartTime = info.activeStartTime;
023      this.level =
024          switch (info.level) {
025            case AlertDataJNI.LEVEL_HIGH -> Level.HIGH;
026            case AlertDataJNI.LEVEL_MEDIUM -> Level.MEDIUM;
027            case AlertDataJNI.LEVEL_LOW -> Level.LOW;
028            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown alert level: " + info.level);
029          };
030    }
031
032    /** The group of the alert. */
033    public final String group;
034
035    /** The alert identifier. */
036    public final String id;
037
038    /** The text of the alert. */
039    public final String text;
040
041    /** The time the alert became active. 0 if not active. */
042    public final long activeStartTime;
043
044    /** The level of the alert (HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW). */
045    public final Level level;
046
047    /**
048     * Returns whether the alert is currently active.
049     *
050     * @return true if the alert is active, false otherwise
051     */
052    public boolean isActive() {
053      return activeStartTime != 0;
054    }
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Gets the number of alerts. Note: this is not guaranteed to be consistent with the number of
059   * alerts returned by GetAll.
060   *
061   * @return the number of alerts
062   */
063  public static int getCount() {
064    return AlertDataJNI.getNumAlerts();
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Gets detailed information about each alert (including inactive ones).
069   *
070   * @return Alerts
071   */
072  public static AlertInfo[] getAll() {
073    AlertDataJNI.AlertInfo[] alertInfos = AlertDataJNI.getAlerts();
074    AlertInfo[] infos = new AlertInfo[alertInfos.length];
075    for (int i = 0; i < alertInfos.length; i++) {
076      infos[i] = new AlertInfo(alertInfos[i]);
077    }
078    return infos;
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Gets detailed information about all active alerts.
083   *
084   * @return Alerts
085   */
086  public static AlertInfo[] getActive() {
087    AlertInfo[] alertInfos = getAll();
088    return java.util.Arrays.stream(alertInfos)
089        .filter(info -> info.activeStartTime != 0)
090        .toArray(AlertInfo[]::new);
091  }
092
093  /** Resets all alert simulation data. */
094  public static void resetData() {
095    AlertDataJNI.resetData();
096  }
097}
